# S370 — Permission question shows the whole command

*Proposed.* The permission question keeps a short title, and carries the full tool input (command or path) in a field that `ork show` and `ork status --json` print in full.

**Findings:** S304 trial 5 (2026-11-16, run ork-20261116-012801-28aa): the approval question title cut a six-path `wc -l` at `.worktrees/S2...`, so the orchestrator had to read the role's Claude transcript to see whether every path was inside the worktree before answering. · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-16** — Permission question keeps a title of at most 120 characters and carries the whole tool input in OwnerQuestion.Detail. ork status --json carries it; run.show includes the live permission question; ork show prints it as sent under Input: (tabs and trailing spaces kept) with heading 'permission question'. Docs updated: design.md, dashboard.md, CHANGELOG.md. Verified: go vet, gofmt, go test ./... (26 packages ok), slicer check, adj lint.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

*Proposed.* An allow decision depends on every token of the command; a cut title cannot be judged, so the owner or delegate either guesses or reads vendor transcripts.
